reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getMonthActionCategories selection and registers through the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapper, though it reads previous-month spending directly from the sheet rather than any shared amount helper (none exists for this).

duplication.why: Copies the per-action loop skeleton (batchMessages + for-of + 'is_income && !isTrackingBudget' skip + expense sign flip) that setZero/set3MonthAvg/set6MonthAvg/set12MonthAvg already repeat, instead of factoring it into a shared iterator.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is exposed in budget/app.ts with the other handlers.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration and tests.

maintainability.why: Short and consistent with the existing actions; the repeated loop skeleton means a change to the income/eligibility rule must again be made in one more place.
